prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a hit while turning left. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1410; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage does not match the story: the dents are on another side and at another height than the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The estimate was reviewed on the vehicle. The reported impact was a left-turn collision at the front, but the deformation sits on the right rear quarter panel and at a lower height than a front-side strike would normally produce, so the described mechanism does not account for the damage pattern. Two similar repair charges appear under the same visit and are being checked before any approval. The labor hours fit the visible damage, and the parts list is reasonable for the work. No earlier damage to this vehicle is known. Repair plan: replace the right rear quarter panel, blend and refinish adjacent surfaces, and recheck the rear alignment before release.
